review.summary: Reviewed the full committed TASK-059D branch against main, excluding AI-review records. No bugs, regressions, security issues, missing tests or out-of-scope changes were found in the database-only bootstrap CLI, the shared email validator reuse, the tests or the backend/deployment/testing/Users documentation. The table lock serializes the emptiness check and insert against all User writers; output stays generic and does not echo input, credentials or database URLs. Ruff and Pyright passed; the full backend suite passed with 417 tests and 42 expected PostgreSQL-gated skips; all 18 focused bootstrap tests passed against a disposable PostgreSQL 18. The production image ran as uid 10001 from /tmp with only DATABASE_URL: an unmigrated database failed generically, and after migrate and reference seed it created one active admin with null audit actors and no identity or session, then refused a repeat invocation without mutation. One low documentation finding: the root README status line was not updated. This review is advisory and does not replace human approval.

findings.summary: Root README still lists administrator bootstrap as pending D.
findings.rationale: AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md were updated to mark the bootstrap as implemented, but the root README status paragraph still says bootstrap is pending D/E/F/G. TASK-059C updated the same paragraph for its own delivery.
findings.recommendation: Update the root README status paragraph to say TASK-059D implements the empty-users-table administrator bootstrap and that production runtime, integrated QA and rollout remain pending G/E/F.

findings.summary: ADR-005 amendment note still lists B/C/D as pending.
findings.rationale: The ADR-005 status note has not been updated since TASK-059B and TASK-059C were delivered, so this predates the branch. It now also misstates TASK-059D. The ADR-013 amendment remains the authoritative source.
findings.recommendation: Ask the developer whether ADR amendment status notes should track delivery. If so, update the note to say only G/E/F remain pending, either in this PR or in a separate docs change.
